title: Initial simulator configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over a finite alphabet $\Gamma$ with decidable equality, choose $a_0\in\Gamma$, and let $x$ be a string over the enlarged sweep alphabet. Let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on the input obtained by replacing each symbol of $x$ by itself when it lies in $\Gamma$, and by $a_0$ otherwise; also choose integers $a,z$ and a natural number $n$. The defined configuration is a configuration of a one-work-tape simulator on $x$, initialized with the encoded state, input-head position, tape zone, boundary markers, and output derived from $c,a,n,z$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite source alphabet with decidable equality
A finite Turing machine over that alphabet
An input string over the enlarged sweep alphabet
A source-machine configuration on the retracted input
caveat: The exact encoded tape contents and head-position transformations are specified by auxiliary constructions not included in the provided informal definitions.
